mapper.select: SELECT TITLE FROM ANS_MAIN_NEWS ORDER BY DT DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT TITLE FROM ANS_BREAKING_NEWS ORDER BY DT DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ANS_MAIN_NEWS
SELECT IDX, TITLE, PRESS, IMG_URL1, URL FROM ANS_MAIN_NEWS ORDER BY DT DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT TITLE FROM ANS_BREAKING_NEWS WHERE TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') UNION SELECT TITLE FROM ANS_MAIN_NEWS WHERE TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) AS search_results
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ANS_BREAKING_NEWS
SELECT IDX, TITLE, PRESS, IMG_URL1, URL FROM ANS_BREAKING_NEWS ORDER BY DT DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT SMR FROM ANS_MAIN_NEWS ORDER BY DT DESC LIMIT 80
SELECT SMR FROM ANS_BREAKING_NEWS ORDER BY DT DESC LIMIT 80
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ANS_FAV (ID, MAIN_IDX, BREAKING_IDX, CREATE_DT) VALUES ( #{id}, CASE WHEN #{mainIdx} IS NOT NULL THEN #{mainIdx} ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{breakingIdx} IS NOT NULL THEN #{breakingIdx} ELSE NULL END, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT n.idx AS idx, n.title AS title, n.smr AS smr, n.press AS press, 'main' AS type FROM ANS_FAV f JOIN ANS_MAIN_NEWS n ON f.main_idx = n.idx WHERE f.id = #{id} ORDER BY f.create_dt DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.idx AS idx, b.title AS title, b.smr AS smr, b.press AS press, 'breaking' AS type FROM ANS_FAV f JOIN ANS_BREAKING_NEWS b ON f.breaking_idx = b.idx WHERE f.id = #{id} ORDER BY f.create_dt DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ANS_FAV WHERE id = #{id} AND MAIN_IDX IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ANS_FAV WHERE id = #{id} AND BREAKING_IDX IS NOT NULL
